The armor features a central vertical ridge, curved shoulder sections (pauldrons), and embossed decorative patterns on the chest area. The surface appears polished with specular highlights indicating a metallic material.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'embossed patterns' checkpoint. In low-res AI images, these often turn into nonsensical noise rather than coherent designs. Verify if the patterns have logical continuity or if they dissolve into texture smear. Also, check if the 'golden' color is consistent with a single material or if there are weird color shifts suggesting multi-material fusion errors.
